out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN WAREWASHING AREA BEING USED TO RINSE NOODLES AND STORE DIRTY DISHES.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED. ITEMS REMOVED FROM SINK. PLEASE RETRAIN YOUR EMPLOYEES.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED IN WALK-IN COOLER: RAW PORK STORED OVER BEEF BROTH. OBSERVED IN ONE-DOOR STANDING COOLER: RAW BEEF STORED OVER CUT VEGETABLES AND GARLIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: RAW FOODS MOVED TO LOWER SHELVES DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE NOTE EHS WILL PROVIDE AN RCP DUE TO REPEAT LACK OF COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. OBSERVED IN THE WALK-IN COOLER: COOKED CORN AT 76F (3HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CDI: COOKED CORN DISPOSED OF. PIC RE-EDUCATED ON ADEQUATE COOLING PROCEDURES.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED ON SHELVING NEAR THE COOKLINE: SOYBEAN SOUP BROTH AT 96F (2.5HR), SEAFOOD BROTH AT 81F (2.5HR), AND BEEF BROTH AT 84F (2.5HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: PUT ON STOVE TO REHEAT TO 165F. PIC RE-EDUCATED ON PROPER HOT HOLDING.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED COMMERCIALLY PREPARED KIMCHI IN A SECONDARY CONTAINER WITHOUT BEING MARKED WITH A DATE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED. PIC MARKED KIMCHI CONTAINERS WITH A DATE DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: BIBIMBAP ON THE MEAT MENU DID NOT HAVE AN ASTERISK AND IS ABLE TO BE SERVED WITH RAW OR UNDERCOOKED EGG.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PLEASE ADD THE ASTERISK TO BIBIMBAP ON THE MEAT MENU BY AUGUST 22ND.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED CONTAINER OF RAID IN SERVING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: RAID DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED BOTTLE OF CEMENT STORED NEXT TO PLASTIC WRAP ABOVE MEAT SLICER.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: CEMENT MOVED DURING INSPECTION. PIC RE-EDUCATED ON PROPER CHEMICAL STORAGE.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED MULTIPLE SQUIRT BOTTLES OF CHEMICALS WITHOUT BEING MARKED WITH A NAME.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CHEMICAL BOTTLES LABELED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Observed employee washing gloved hands
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. PIC stopped employee had them dispose of gloves and wash hands properly

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed in the walk in cooler raw beef being stored RTE bean paste and sauces
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC moved raw beef so it was not being stored over RTE foods

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Observed concentration @ 10 ppm
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. PIC replaced sanitizer container, when tested corrected level was 50 ppm

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes do not have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents, backdoor of facility
violations.corrective_action: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes shall have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents by 1) 16 mesh to 25.4mm (16 mesh to 1 inch) screens; 2) properly designed and installed air curtains to control flying insects; or 3) other effective means PIC shut door of the facility

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: knives were stored between the 2 door and 3 door prep top cooler on the Cookline
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed knives and them washed and cleaned

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils, No Cloth Drying
violations.observation: Equipment after being washed in mechanical washing machine were observed cloth-dried rather than air-dried after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils may not be cloth dried. PIC stopped employee had them air drying equipment

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Employees where observed in the kitchen washing gloved hands without removing gloves to facilitate proper handwashing
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. Person in Charge stopped employees and had them remove their gloves and wash their hands

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed in the walk in cooler raw beef muscle being stored on shelving over the RTE sauces and raw fish being stored RTE rice cakes
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. person in charge moved items in walk in cooler so the Raw animal products were being stored under the RTE food

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: rice was observed in the hot holding cabinet below the minimum hot holding temperature at 115F, 116F, 117F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Person in charge disposed of rice at the improper hot holding temperature

violations.title: Thermometers, Location in Holding Units
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device in the following mechanically refrigerated unit was not properly located in the warmest part of the unit: the 3 door prep top cooler and 2 door prep top cooler on the cookline died not have thermometers located in the warmest parts of the unit
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanically refrigerated unit the sensor of a temperature measuring device shall be located to measure the air temperature of a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of the refrigerator. Store the thermometer near the door of the unit. Person in charge moved the in unit thermometers

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: Observed no read, agreed and signed employee illness reporting agreements in the establishment at the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. PIC printed employee illness reporting agreements and. Had staff read and agree and sign.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC printed and provided handwashing signs at all handwashing sinks. THE WOO KOREAN BBQ (Inspection Date: 04/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device at the beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC acquired thermometers during inspection.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Bags of rice, bags of wheat flour, and onions stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC moved items so they were so stored at least six’s inches off the floor

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Operated per Data Plate
violations.observation: EHS observed the chemical sanitizing ware washing machine in the kitchen area not dispensing sanitizer, 0ppm per manufacturers data plate.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine and its auxiliary components shall be operated in accordance with the machine's data plate and other manufacturer's instructions. PIC called repair company during inspection. PIC had employees set up 3 compartment sink for wash rinse and sanitize.
